notes: This contract pins Umbra's opt-in, non-installable IEEE 1516.1-2025 object-class attribute declaration foundation to the exact C++ API surfaces exported by the Requirements Lab. It verifies official signatures, declared exception sets, adapter symbols, and real Catch2 selectors. The implementation retains explicit publication and active/passive subscription state for available attributes, including inherited handles; only active declarations feed the bounded discovery, scope, and reflected-update routes, while passive state remains retained without arranging delivery. A separate limited registration/discovery contract consumes that state and applies the implicit privilege-to-delete effect when it snapshots an unnamed registered instance. This declaration contract deliberately does not claim whole-class declarations, regional declaration advisories, update-rate enforcement, regions, full ownership, packaging, or conformance. The Lab exports no higher-level implementation mapping for these services, so this is source/API traceability only, not a catalog or validation claim.
